subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83440 be narrowed to read-only pending inspection for this issue, or should the CLI also gain direct approval-resolution authority?
rationale: Listing pending requests satisfies the reported visibility gap, while resolve/respond changes how operators exercise approval authority; repository evidence cannot determine that product and security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land listing first
options.body: Keep pending/list with table and JSON output under `operator.approvals`, and defer resolve/respond to separately approved work.

options.title: Approve combined CLI
options.body: Keep listing and resolution together after explicit authorization review and live Gateway proof of sanitization, decisions, expiry, and error handling.

recommendation.title: Land listing first
recommendation.body: Keep pending/list with table and JSON output under `operator.approvals`, and defer resolve/respond to separately approved work.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent durable approvals proposal directly addresses cross-surface authorization and resolution semantics, making them the strongest available decision route.
